meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行 ESM 模型进行蛋白质结构预测与推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质结构或运行 ESM 模型推理。
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and run ESM model inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict protein structures or run ESM model inference.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能按 esm 文档帮你写 Python 代码:用 ESM3 生成或补全蛋白序列、预测结构,用 ESMC 提取嵌入,用 ESMFold2 做折叠预测,并给出对应模型与参数。
howto.when: 当你在代码或对话中直接用 esm SDK、ESM3/ESMC 模型、Forge/Biohub 客户端,或要求蛋白序列生成、结构预测、嵌入计算等任务时触发。

say.text: 用 esm3-open 补全这段序列:MPRT___KEND
say.note: Claude 会给出补全代码和结果。

say.text: 用 ESMC 计算这几条蛋白序列的嵌入向量
say.note: Claude 会写批量嵌入的 Python 代码。

say.text: 用 ESMFold2 预测这个 PDB 文件的结构
say.note: Claude 会给出结构预测的调用方式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write Python code per the esm docs: generate or complete protein sequences with ESM3, predict structures, extract embeddings with ESMC, and run ESMFold2 folding, with appropriate model and parameter choices.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you directly mention the esm SDK, ESM3/ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub clients, or request protein sequence generation, structure prediction, or embedding computation.

say_en.text: Complete this sequence with esm3-open: MPRT___KEND
say_en.note: Claude will provide completion code and output.

say_en.text: Compute embeddings for these protein sequences with ESMC
say_en.note: Claude will write batch embedding code.

say_en.text: Predict the structure of this PDB file with ESMFold2
say_en.note: Claude will show how to call the folding workflow.
